flashcard_questions.q: An endothermic chemical reaction in which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen.
Organelles found in plant cells and algae that contain chlorophyll and are the site of photosynthesis.
A green pigment found in chloroplasts that absorbs light energy for photosynthesis.

flashcard_questions.a: A factor that limits the rate of a reaction when it is in short supply, even if other factors are present in abundance.
The extra oxygen the body needs after vigorous exercise to break down the lactic acid that has accumulated in muscles.
